recognize_zh: 周邊血液拼圖中多顆中等大小的淋巴球，細胞質深藍、核偏位且染色質較粗，部分可見核旁淡染區（hof），形態像漿細胞，屬病毒感染（水痘）時的反應性漿細胞樣淋巴球。
features: Medium-sized lymphocytes with moderate amounts of deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Round to oval, often eccentric nuclei with moderately coarse, clumped chromatin; no conspicuous nucleoli
Occasional faint perinuclear clearing (hof) imparting a plasmacytoid appearance
Population is morphologically heterogeneous, mixed with small lymphocytes and normal neutrophils
Background red cells show crenation (echinocytic artifact) and adequate platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (composite) shows increased reactive lymphocytes, many with a plasmacytoid appearance: medium size, deeply basophilic cytoplasm, eccentric round nuclei with coarse chromatin, and occasional perinuclear hofs. The population is heterogeneous, admixed with small mature lymphocytes and unremarkable neutrophils, and blasts are not seen. Red cells show crenation artifact. In a child with varicella, findings are consistent with reactive plasmacytoid lymphocytosis secondary to viral infection.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell leukemia / circulating myeloma cells
ddx.vs: Circulating clonal plasma cells are more uniform, frequently show a well-defined hof, nucleoli or atypia, occur in adults, and show light-chain restriction.
LPL cells are a monotonous clonal B-cell population with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P, not a heterogeneous transient reactive population in a febrile child.
EBV-reactive lymphocytes are larger with abundant cytoplasm scalloping around red cells and peripheral basophilia rather than compact deep-blue plasmacytoid cytoplasm.
Lymphoblasts have fine dispersed chromatin, high N:C ratio and scant cytoplasm, unlike these condensed-chromatin cells with abundant basophilic cytoplasm.
